propositions: Existing managed links must be backfilled as confirmed-at-upgrade records to prevent the first post-upgrade pass from declining all legitimate peer deletions
Backfill only runs when the peer confirmation store file was absent at open (fresh upgrade), not when the file exists but is empty
Each managed ref with a bound target receives a backfilled record with source=backfill and direction=backfill; unbound targets are skipped
Backfill never downgrades provenance: it skips writing if a record already exists with push or snapshot source, while later snapshot confirmation overwrites backfilled entries
The evidence step uses a single store instance, with backfill running first and snapshot confirmation second on the same instance to ensure visibility and prevent lost updates
